name: statechart
description: Check a TLA+ model of a system that moves between states (a product flow, a protocol, a service) with TLC, and draw it as a Mermaid statechart in the reader's words, with the shortest path to each state that breaks a rule. Use when the user runs /statechart, asks to model-check a state machine or protocol with TLA+, or wants a bug shown as a path through states. Python, run with uv; adapted from Lauren Tan's pstack (Cursor).
